title: Joint integral tensor-Hom presentations normalized by reduced evaluation
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $X$, and a finite-field datum $D$ whose characteristic differs from $\ell$. Use the completed coefficient sheaf and finite reductions of [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], the ambient internal Hom of [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], and the fixed closed coefficient calculus [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. There is one integral TensorPresentation $a$ [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models] and, for each $n\ge0$, a ReductionPresentation $m_n$ of $a$ over $\mathcal O_E/(t^{n+1})$ such that for every pair of ambient derived objects $K,M$, the fixed finite closed adjunction uncurries $\operatorname{comparison}(m_n,K,M)$ to $\mu_n^{-1}(H(K,M),K)$ followed by integral reduction of the fixed evaluation $H(K,M)\otimes K\to M$. Here $\mu_n$ is the fixed integral-to-finite tensorator. Only normalization is asserted; invertibility is a separate existing theorem.

source.place: Proof sentence: The general Hom comparisons are defined by the same evaluation maps.

proof.text: Use the fixed natural closed adjunction on every ambient integral input and transport it by Koszul symmetry to the K tensor Hom convention. Its total-tensor and Hom-complex models give a TensorPresentation whose counit is the specified signed evaluation.

For each finite quotient use the fixed finite closed structure and tensorator, conjugated by the same Koszul symmetry. Its pure-tensor equation and normalized scalar unit/counit square give the reduction presentation, using the same integral presentation for all n.

Expand IntegralHom.comparison and uncurry in the original Hom tensor K convention. The transported adjunctions cancel the symmetry and give exactly finiteTensor inverse followed by reduced evaluation. The adjunction was chosen at every ambient input; no inference from normalization only on K-flat objects is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem integralHom_presentation_evaluation (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p) :
    ∃ a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E X D hl),
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : IntegralHom.ReductionPresentation l E X D hl a n,
        ∀ K M : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E X D hl,
          ((finiteIntrinsicClosed l E X n).transpose _
            ((coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K)
            ((coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E X n).obj M)).symm
              (IntegralHom.comparison l E X D hl m K M) =
            ((coefficientDerivedSystemEvaluationCalculus l E X).choose.finiteTensor n).inv.app
                ((coefficientIntegralInternalHom l E X).obj (op K, M), K) ≫
              (coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E X n).map
                ((scalarIntegralClosed l E X).evaluation K M)
